reason: A DSH web session-management panel for browsing, searching, grouping, archiving, restoring, inspecting, opening, and selectively deleting local conversations and related files.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中集中浏览、搜索、归档、恢复、查看并选择性删除本机对话及其关联文件。
summaries.en: A DSH settings panel for browsing, searching, archiving, restoring, inspecting, opening, and selectively deleting local conversations and related files.

capabilities: Browses and searches local conversation sessions
Permanently deletes selected sessions with confirmation
Optionally deletes selected child sessions and produced or downloaded files
Opens session record folders in the system file manager
Displays session metadata, activity statistics, related sessions, and files
